summary: SLB Limited/NV filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $2 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes by its subsidiary Schlumberger Investment S.A., split into three tranches (4.550% Notes due 2031 for $500M, 4.800% Notes due 2033 for $500M, and 5.150% Notes due 2036 for $1B). The notes are fully guaranteed by SLB and were sold via underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan, HSBC, and Standard Chartered as representatives. Terms are standard for an investment-grade debt offering; there are no acquisition, spin-off, or other special-situation elements. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, not a special situation.
